title: The Lost Donkey (The Joy of Gratitude)
summary: Nasruddin was searching the town for his lost donkey, singing joyous hymns and thanking heaven at the top of his voice....
full_text:
Nasruddin was searching the town for his lost donkey, singing joyous hymns and thanking heaven at the top of his voice.

The villagers asked: "Mulla, why do you sing with such joy when your donkey is lost?"

"Because," smiled Nasruddin, "if I had been riding on it when it wandered off, I would be lost too! Thank heaven I was walking on my own two feet!"
moral: Looking for the silver lining in every loss keeps the heart joyful and serene.
